verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for a cloud browser automation platform with an SDK, CLI and MCP server, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack describes a telemetry opt-out, an environment variable to disable usage tracking, or any analytics controls. The stealth/anonymity and credential-vault items concern browsing fingerprints and secrets, not the product's own telemetry, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
